execution_routes.direct: BODY target -> arm BASE -> active TCP IK -> guarded JAKA joint_move
execution_routes.curobo: BODY target -> arm planning frame -> cuRobo trajectory -> supervised JAKA servo_j

zero.description: All six joints at controller zero; arms extend northwest/northeast.

ready.description: Normalized hand-posed posture: symmetric BODY positions and forward-facing physical grippers.

forward.description: Both arms extend toward BODY +X with mirrored Y positions.

up.description: Both arms toward BODY +Z; grippers forward and finger-closing direction vertical.

side.description: Left arm toward BODY +Y and right arm toward BODY -Y.
side.site_visual_confirmation: confirmed after manual reposition; side pose visually acceptable

folded.description: Right arm folds the held tray in front of the body so it leaves the body-camera view (BODY z=1.20 m, radius 0.295 m, azimuth -35.5 deg). Tray held level: tool Y along BODY +Z, tool Z toward BODY +Y -- the only orientation that is both level and left-facing for this grip (compare `ready`, whose right arm has tool Y = BODY -Z and would tip the tray). This is the only pose here that is commissioned while holding a payload. Left arm is recorded at its measured parked joints and was not part of this commissioning.
folded.commissioning_scope: right arm only: IK/FK 6.0e-6 m / 0.0034 deg; trip 39.49 deg of the 150 deg native cap; BODY y=-0.172 m satisfies the y<=-0.070 m central-slab exclusion; arm-link vs body-chassis and non-adjacent self-collision clear; executed live twice at 0.10 rad/s on 2026-09-28. NOT verified: cuRobo point-cloud-level collision for the carried tray, left-arm path. Left joint_rad is the measured parked reading (3 dp), not a designed target.

center.description: Right arm holds the carried tray 80 mm to the right of the BODY centreline and dead level, at the height the operator dragged. BODY y=-0.080 m is the closest the arm may approach the centre: the y<=-0.070 m central-slab exclusion leaves 10 mm of margin. This is NOT the BODY centre and NOT the placement point -- it is a precise tuck, produced by regularising the 2026-09-28 hand-drag, which arrived 2.86 deg off level at y=-0.055 m. Orientation is the level-preserving one for this grip: tool Z = BODY +Y (straight left), tool Y = BODY +Z (tray horizontal), tool X = -BODY X. Left arm is its measured parked reading and was not part of this design.
center.commissioning_scope: RIGHT ARM ONLY. Executed live once on 2026-09-28 via ares_r.motion.production_scene_worker (cspace plan, 121 knots, path clearance 0.0651 m with the carried tray declared as an attached collision object) -> package_native_preview -> jaka_right_supervised_path_v6_pick supervised_path at 0.10 rad/s and 0.20 rad/s^2: 138 samples, 10.96 s, target_reached, servo_disabled code=0, no abort. Endpoint read back with 0.0000 deg joint residual on all six joints. The controller reports TCP (339.0395, -166.6447, -172.4692) mm = BODY (0.357573, -0.078098, 1.027531) m, i.e. 2.06 mm from the nominal BODY target -- that is the pre-existing URDF-versus-controller model offset (the read-only audit reports 1.88 mm on the same pair), not a following error. Central-exclusion margin +8.1 mm at the endpoint and +10.0 mm at worst along the planned path; tray tilt 3.587 -> 0.000 deg and never worse than the start; zero arm-versus-body and self collisions across the packaged path; the gripper stayed closed on the held object (raw 39). NOT verified: left-arm path, and the obstacle_demo/obstacle_demo_worker planner route plus the direct MoveJ route, neither of which was ever exercised for this pose. Left joint_rad is a measured parked reading (6 dp), not a designed target.
